name: _carousel-overrides.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  internals/_carousel-overrides.scss — internals items rendered inside
//  a .carousel track: symmetric item padding restoration, slide-loading
//  state, the no-WebGL carousel fallback, and the .project section reset.
//  Imported by internals.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Carousel context overrides
// Each .internal-extra-item is the sole child of its .carousel-slide, so
// :first-of-type and :last-of-type both match every item — zeroing out the
// padding on both sides. Restore symmetric padding here so items have visible
// gaps between them in the carousel track.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.carousel .internal-extra-item {
  @include layout-1024() {
    // Desktop clearance: ≥24px margin on each side of the item — combined
    // with the item padding this keeps every media box (and its
    // click-to-open affordance) visually separated from neighbours.
    margin-inline: to-rem(24);
  }

  &:first-of-type {
    padding-left: var(--space-lg);
  }
  &:last-of-type {
    padding-right: var(--space-lg);
  }

  @include layout-768() {
    &:first-of-type {
      padding-left: var(--space-xl);
    }
    &:last-of-type {
      padding-right: var(--space-xl);
    }
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    &:first-of-type {
      padding-left: var(--space-2xl);
    }
    &:last-of-type {
      padding-right: var(--space-2xl);
    }
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    &:first-of-type {
      padding-left: var(--space-3xl);
    }
    &:last-of-type {
      padding-right: var(--space-3xl);
    }
  }
}

// Non-visible carousel slide placeholder: centre the loading spinner
.carousel-slide--loading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Single landscape image (not in carousel — carousel-fallback)
// Must have the same MAXAREA lateral padding as all other grid content.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.carousel-fallback {
  @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

  padding: var(--space-2xl) 0;
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
}

.carousel-fallback .internal-extra-item.landscape {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Parallax effect removed: sections render with full opacity and normal layout flow
.project section {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}
